# Travis Lenkner speaks with ALM/Law.com about law firm equity


- Law firm equity


August 14, 2025


-
-
-
-


In an ALM/Law.com article entitled "PE, Lit Funders Eye Investments in Big Law Back Offices," Burford Chief Development Officer[Travis Lenkner](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/travis-lenkner/) discusses law firm equity, where he says, "This is the most natural thing in the world for us to be engaged in pretty heavily in the coming years; the question is the speed at which the market ultimately moves in this direction."


[Read the full article here.](https://www.law.com/2025/08/14/the-law-firm-disrupted-pe-lit-funders-eye-investments-in-big-law-back-offices/)
